lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
List three planning decisions a choral group should make before performing a short poem.

FEEDBACK
Who starts; where to pause; how loud the refrain is — or similar clear cues.

CHECK
Everyone shouting different speeds hides the words.

INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Plan and perform a choral reading of a short poem. Record cue decisions and one improvement after rehearsal.

Write a short reflection describing one specific revision you made and why.
